business_summary: Nanning Department Store Co., Ltd. engages in commercial retail business in the People's Republic of China. It is involved in department stores, home appliances, supermarkets, automobiles, and e-commerce business. Nanning Department Store Co., Ltd. was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Nanning, China.
business_summary_ko: Nanning Department Store Co., Ltd.는 중화인민공화국에서 상업 소매업에 종사하고 있습니다. 백화점, 가전제품, 슈퍼마켓, 자동차, 전자상거래 사업에 참여하고 있습니다. Nanning Department Store Co., Ltd.는 1956년에 설립되었으며 중국 난닝에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
